Final turn: reported PASS (dotnet build succeeded, 0 WUI warnings, smoke launch pid 9804 stayed alive), confirming the migration was actually complete and correct.

tools_problematic.problem: Threw 'Source not found' on the first invocation (Turn 2) with the correct prompt-supplied path, because the UWP source directory had not yet materialized on disk at that moment; the same path succeeded at Turn 22.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt L268-273 (throw) vs L736-765 (same path, success).

tool_limitations.limitation: On a missing -Source it throws immediately with no hint that the source is expected to be the local prompt-supplied path and must not be reconstructed from the internet.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Skill Step 0 should state the source is always local (path given in the task prompt), never fetched from the web, and a transient 'Source not found' should be retried against the same path.

failed_apis.why_tried: The UWP page Scenario1_ChatClient.xaml.cs (and MainPage.xaml.cs) subscribe to App.Current.Suspending += App_Suspending to persist chat state.
failed_apis.root_cause: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application has no Suspending event; WinUI 3 desktop apps are not OS-suspended.
failed_apis.fix: Agent settled on Windows.ApplicationModel.Core.CoreApplication.Suspending (compiles); faithful migration is to remove the subscription/handler or move state-save to normal desktop close.

special_apis.special_handling: No Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application equivalent. Remove the subscription (desktop apps aren't suspended by the OS) or use the compile-compatible Windows.ApplicationModel.Core.CoreApplication.Suspending only for packaged suspend/resume scenarios.

errors_encountered.error: CS1061: 'Application' does not contain a definition for 'Suspending'
errors_encountered.root_cause: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application dropped the UWP Suspending event.
errors_encountered.fix: Rewire to Windows.ApplicationModel.Core.CoreApplication.Suspending, or remove the handler.

errors_encountered.error: CS0103: The name 'App' does not exist in the current context (Scenario1_ChatClient.xaml.cs, MainPage.xaml.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Copied page referenced the App class unqualified while resolving the Suspending line; same App/lifecycle cluster.
errors_encountered.fix: Reference Application.Current / the scaffold App type in the project namespace; resolved together with the Suspending fix.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Initialize threw 'Source not found' for the correct prompt path; agent then ran ~18 turns of directory hunting and SIX web_fetch calls to github.com/microsoft/Windows-universal-samples trying to reconstruct the sample from the internet before retrying the local path successfully at Turn 22.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: UWP source materialized on disk after the first Initialize call (harness timing); the skill offers no guidance that the source is always local and must not be fetched from the web, so the agent defaulted to online reconstruction.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Retried the same local path at Turn 22; Initialize succeeded.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: SKILL.md Step 0 rule: the UWP source is always the local prompt-supplied path; never fetch it from GitHub/learn; on a transient 'Source not found' re-verify the prompt path and retry.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: CS1061 on Application.Suspending and CS0103 on App forced extra build-fix iterations at the very end of the budget.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md has zero coverage of the near-universal UWP Application.Suspending pattern, so the agent had to discover the fix by trial during the final (timeout-adjacent) turns.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add an Application.Suspending pattern to the lifecycle section so it is fixed mechanically/early instead of in the final loop.

env_issues.workaround: Retry the same local path; it materializes shortly after.

env_issues.issue: Trial recorded builds:false/runs:false/timeout:true even though the app built, launched, and scored 100% parity in the scoring trial.
